## 32d6c6648427

**Verdict: Reproduced teaching defect.** The target source was not modified.

The assigned generator SHA-256 is
`b07ae60f9e2e5ac54057a5aafc24878345d9a8fe5f5553c8a06e44240a48ccb8`; the selected
Racket authority executed with rule hash `62476150d7d4`. At medium difficulty, seed `0`
and sample indices `[3,4,5,6]` produce a four-pair lesson whose three demonstrations
all have operation code `1` (AND), while the query has operation code `2` (OR).
Every input passes the target generator's `self_check` and was generated by its normal
documented sampler domain.

The rival “treat every operation code as AND” exactly matches all three Racket-labeled
demonstrations and differs on the Racket-labeled query. Therefore the labels are
individually correct but the lesson does not teach the distinction required by its own
query.

Supported authority command, run from packet root (the wrapper reports effective cwd
`repo`):

```text
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 32d6c6648427 --input ../checks/audit/32d6c6648427/input.json --out ../checks/audit/32d6c6648427/racket.json
```

The command exited `0`. Evidence:
`checks/audit/32d6c6648427/input.json`, `racket.json`, `rival.json`, `probe.json`,
`verification.json`, and `apply-command.log`.
